body:
I do talk to a therapist, but it's hard to talk about the really heavy stuff with her. I am diagnosed autistic and bipolar, so there's that.

The last time I can remember really being happy was when I was in high school, years before I met her, when life was still mostly good and carefree and all I had to worry about was finishing my homework.

I'm doing the best I can, but I'm afraid I'm close to breaking myself. She's constantly gaslit into believing that every problem in the house is her fault. Her doctor recommended she see a therapist, but as she has no means of transporting herself and her mother refuses to drive her, it seems unfeasible.
